newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end lower, Enersis skids.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end lower, Enersis skids.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed softer in modest trade with power investment company Enersis sinking on disappointing year-end results, said dealers.
The bolsa is seen unsettled on Monday as investors wait for the last company earnings figures to be released, they said.
The 40-share index ended down 1.25 percent at 115.97 points. The general index lost 0.73 percent to 5,368.8 points amid volume of 10.66 billion pesos.
